university.name: Liverpool John Moores University
university.summary: Liverpool John Moores University publishes international undergraduate and postgraduate taught fees and country entry requirements. Its Pakistan page states it will not accept applications from Pakistan for 2026/27. Pathway programmes (foundation year, pre-masters, international year one) are delivered with Study Group at the LJMU International Study Centre.

courses.title: International Foundation Year: Business, Law and Social Studies
courses.award: International Foundation Year (LJMU International Study Centre)
courses.duration_text: 2 semesters (27 to 30 weeks depending on start date)
courses.overview: A two-semester foundation programme delivered at the LJMU International Study Centre for international students, preparing for undergraduate study in business, law and social studies at Liverpool John Moores University. Classes are attended in person.
highlights: Elective assigned by progression degree: Accounting and Financial Management, or Law
courses.academic_requirements: Good high school graduation grades or equivalent academic study. Age 17+ (must turn 18 by 31 December of the year of joining the undergraduate programme). Pakistan: Year 10 (SSC) 60% overall or 65% (grade scale dependent); Year 11 (Intermediate Part I) 55% overall with passes in at least 4 subjects; Year 12 (HSC / Intermediate Part I and II) or Polytechnic Diploma 50% overall with passes in at least 4 subjects.
courses.english_requirements: Academic IELTS for UKVI overall 4.5 (minimum 4.0 in each area). A UKVI-approved SELT may be used (IELTS Academic for UKVI, Trinity Integrated Skills in English UKVI, Pearson PTE Academic UKVI, LanguageCert International ESOL SELT, PSI Skills for English UKVI). Results must be within the past 24 months. The page does not mention Duolingo.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The ISC entry page lists Pakistan requirements by qualification: SSC 60% (or 65% depending on grade scale), Intermediate Part I 55%, HSC/Intermediate or Polytechnic Diploma 50%. The structured percentage below is the HSC route. Note the university's own Pakistan page states it will not accept applications from Pakistan for 2026/27; whether this affects the pathway programme is not stated.
courses.notes: Fee is the 2026/27 fee (valid for programmes starting on or after 26 August 2026); 2027/28 fee not yet published. The semester dates page lists a September 2027 start (20/9/2027) for the International Foundation Year, but the programme page lists October, November, January and May entry points, so confirm the September 2027 start with the Study Centre. The fees page lists the programme as 2 semesters; whether the figure is total for both semesters is inferred from that label.

courses.title: Pre-Masters Programme: Business, Management and Law
courses.overview: A one-semester pre-masters programme at the LJMU International Study Centre for international students progressing to selected postgraduate degrees at Liverpool John Moores University. A degree not necessarily related to the programme is acceptable.
highlights: Global Business Management and Marketing Principles (core)
courses.academic_requirements: A recognised first degree. Business, Management and Law: a degree not necessarily related to the programme is acceptable. Age 20+. Pakistan: 2 year Bachelor's (Regular Pass) with at least 1 year work experience 55%; 3 year Bachelor's (Hons) 45% overall; 3 year Bachelor's (Regular Pass) 45% overall; 4 year Bachelor's (any) 45% overall; 3 year Diploma 55% overall (only if taken after Year 11 or 12); associate degree not eligible.
courses.english_requirements: Academic IELTS for UKVI 5.5 (minimum 5.5 in all sub skills). Duolingo English Test minimum 105 is listed but is not accepted for Pakistan applicants, who require a SELT. Results must be within the past 24 months.
courses.experience_requirements: 2 year Bachelor's (Regular Pass) applicants from Pakistan need at least 1 year of work experience.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan route recorded is the 4 year Bachelor's at 45% overall; other routes are quoted in academic_requirements. The university's own Pakistan page states it will not accept applications from Pakistan for 2026/27; whether this affects the pathway programme is not stated.
courses.notes: Semester dates page lists Pre-Masters starts of 12/4/2027 and 10/4/2028 only, so there is no September 2027 start. Fee is the 2026/27 fee; 2027/28 fee not yet published. The programme page's progression degree table showed no results.

scholarships.name: International Achievement Scholarship (Undergraduate progression)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 3,000 partial tuition fee scholarship for each year of undergraduate study at LJMU
scholarships.summary: Awarded automatically to self-funded students who achieve the required progression grades at the LJMU International Study Centre and move on to an undergraduate degree at LJMU.
scholarships.criteria_text: Achieve the required progression grades at the International Study Centre, be self-funded, receive no external funding such as government or employer sponsorship, and meet the conditions in the offer letter.
scholarships.notes: Partner (Study Group) page. Eligible countries and intake not stated on the page; INTL assumed from the page being for international Study Centre students. Academic year the terms apply to not stated.
